name: QD Quad Drum Voice
source: vpme.de QD - Quad Drum Voice - User Manual v1.10.pdf p.1 (features/user interface); https://vpme.de/qd/ (4 trigger inputs, 4 assignable CV inputs, 2 output channels); ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026): panel prints TRIG and CV per voice, OUT L and OUT R
notes: Manual has no panel image and the official panel image could not be retrieved, so labels are inferred: trigger inputs sit on the left/right edges in the voice-square layout (voice 1 bottom-left, 2, 3, 4); CV 1-4 are the assignable CV inputs; OUT L/OUT R are the main stereo mix outputs (manual calls them main outputs 1 and 2) (manual: 'QD main outputs 1 and 2'; QEX adds OUT 3/4). With CV STEP TRIGGERS enabled each CV can act as a sample-step trigger; CV 4 can select presets via a setting.
